dataBits.description: Number of data bits per frame

stopBits.description: Number of stop bits per frame

unitId.description: Modbus unit/slave ID (0 = broadcast, 1-247 = specific device)

readTimeoutMs.description: Read operation response timeout in milliseconds

writeTimeoutMs.description: Write operation response timeout in milliseconds

interFrameTimeoutMs.description: Inter-frame silence timeout in milliseconds (3.5 character times at 9600 baud ≈ 4ms)

connectionSummary: Modbus RTU client workflow for RS-485 and serial-connected devices.
connectionSteps: Choose the target COM port from the live serial resource list.
Match the baud rate and unit address used by the field device.
After connection, read and write registers. CRC is appended and validated automatically.
readBehavior: Read operations emit a complete RTU frame and validate CRC on the received response. Supports FC01 (Read Coils), FC02 (Read Discrete Inputs), FC03 (Read Holding Registers), and FC04 (Read Input Registers).
writeBehavior: Write operations support FC05 (Write Single Coil), FC06 (Write Single Register), FC15 (Write Multiple Coils), and FC16 (Write Multiple Registers). CRC is appended and validated automatically.
